name: Desktop
description:
Here is a 5-line summary:

1. **New view** creation now saves the current layout and resets the desktop grid, giving the user a blank canvas to start fresh.
2. **Edit/rename view** only renames the existing view without touching the desktop layout.
3. A **"Save copy"** button was added (visible only in edit mode) to save the current desktop layout as a new view under a different name.
4. A `resetDesktop` action was added to the UI store, safely removing all dockview panels and clearing `openApps` state.
5. The `ViewProperties.vue` component was updated to handle all three flows (`create`, `rename`, `save copy`) by calling the appropriate store actions.

messages.content:
When view properties click confirm we must update the current view. In the case of new one we'll reset the grid view so user can add or remove panels.
Allow in the views properties to "Save copy" with new name over a modified view.
